faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about wholesale purchases, delivery, and our services.
faq.generalTitle: Get to Know Duo Caesar Better
faq.q1: What are the store operating hours?
faq.a1: Our store serves customers during designated operating hours. To ensure service availability, please visit the contact page.
faq.a2: There is no minimum purchase at our offline store, please shop according to your needs and we will serve you well.
faq.q3: Are there products other than food and beverages?
faq.a3: For now, our store only provides food and beverage products. Hopefully in the future our store will also provide other necessities.
faq.a4: Customers can view stock availability through the product page, or inquire directly via WhatsApp.
faq.a5: Customers can visit our offline store directly at the listed address, or order via WhatsApp if the address allows.
faq.q6: What is the ordering process via WhatsApp?
faq.a6: Contact our WhatsApp number and inform the product and quantity you want to order. Our team will help process the order and provide further information.
faq.a7: No, ordering via WhatsApp can only be done if the orderer's address is <5km
faq.a8: Delivery will be done directly by the store owner, so the delivery process can be guaranteed safe.
